  external_ref text,             -- no index or constraint; every existing value is unique and non-NULL
  qty int NOT NULL,
  status text NOT NULL,
  amount numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now());                                        -- 5,000,000 rows

- **Roles.** Your script connects as `migrator`, which owns these tables but is NOT a superuser. The application connects as `app`, which has SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE on these tables (SELECT/INSERT on any extra table described above) and USAGE on the sequences that exist now. Each one stays open for a random 6–12 seconds, then the job pauses for a random 1–3 seconds before starting the next one. One such transaction is already open when your script starts. You cannot cancel it and must not try.

- It runs once as `psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f migration.sql`, connected as `migrator`, in psql's default autocommit mode (no outer transaction). It must finish within 60 seconds.
